title: Numbering
footer: Numbers only go up, and sequences cannot be deleted.
readOnlyNotice: Read-only access. You can't add or change sequences.
companyLoadFailed: Companies could not be loaded, so names and the company filter are limited.

modal.readOnly: You can view this sequence but not change it.

fields.codeHint: Letters A-Z, digits and . _ : -, up to 64, starting with a letter or digit. Other modules find the sequence by this code. Can't be changed later.
fields.companyHint: Applies to one company or to the whole workspace. Can't be changed after saving.
fields.prefixHint: Optional. Up to 16 letters, digits or . _ : / # - with no spaces. Shown before the number.
fields.paddingHint: Minimum digits in the number, from 1 to 12. Longer numbers are not cut.
fields.startValueHint: First number this sequence issues. A whole number from 1 to 9007199254740991.
fields.nextValueHint: The next number to issue. It can only be raised, never lowered. Current value: {{current}}.

preview.title: Next number preview
preview.incomplete: Complete the prefix, digits and number to see the preview.
preview.nonConsuming: Previewing does not use up a number.
preview.counterNote: Changing the prefix or digits affects only numbers issued from now on.
preview.failed: The saved value could not be loaded.

validation.codeFormat: Use A-Z, digits and . _ : - only, starting with a letter or digit, up to 64.
validation.prefixFormat: Use up to 16 letters, digits or . _ : / # - with no spaces.
validation.paddingRange: Enter a whole number from 1 to 12.
validation.counterFormat: Enter a whole number from 1 to 9007199254740991.
validation.counterLower: The next number can't be lower than the current value ({{current}}).

discard.title: Discard changes?
discard.text: Your edits to this sequence will be lost.
